Unauthorized Stream Access via Unprotected MediaStore Container [Information Disclosure, Spoofing, CWE-284] on ElementalMediastore, CloudFront Distribution, MediaStore Container Policy: The MediaStore container policy allows any AWS principal to GetObject and DescribeObject. Attackers could potentially access the MediaStore endpoint directly, bypassing CloudFront and its security controls. An attacker discovers the MediaStore endpoint and directly downloads stream segments, bypassing geographic

Insecure RTMP Ingestion Points [Spoofing, Tampering, CWE-306] on ElementalMediaLive, MediaLive Input Security Group, RTMP Ingestion Endpoints: The security group allows unrestricted RTMP access from any IP address, relying solely on stream key authentication. An attacker could attempt to brute force stream keys or exploit RTMP vulnerabilities to inject unauthorized content into the streaming platform.

Insufficient DRM Implementation [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-311] on ElementalMediaLive, ElementalMediaStore, CloudFront Distribution: Without DRM, stream content is vulnerable to capture and redistribution. HLS segments can be downloaded and reconstructed into complete videos. A malicious user captures HLS segments and redistributes the content on unauthorized platforms.

Vulnerable WebSocket Chat Implementation [Spoofing, Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-306] on API Gateway WebSocket API, Lambda Chat Handler, DynamoDB Chat Table, SQS Chat Queue: The WebSocket routes are configured with 'NONE' authorization type, allowing any client to connect and send messages. An attacker could connect to the WebSocket API and flood the chat with malicious messages or harvest user messages and metadata.

Insufficient Geographic Access Controls [Information Disclosure, CWE-284] on CloudFront Distribution, API Gateway, Lambda Functions: Without proper geographic restrictions, content can be accessed from any location, potentially violating licensing agreements. Users employ VPNs to access geo-restricted content from unauthorized regions.

Insecure Stream Recording Storage [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-732] on S3 Recording Bucket, MediaLive Recording Output, IAM Roles: Stream recordings stored in S3 could be vulnerable to unauthorized access or tampering if bucket policies or encryption settings are misconfigured. An attacker gains access to stored recordings through misconfigured IAM policies or bucket settings.

Redis Cache Security Vulnerabilities [Information Disclosure, Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-319] on ElastiCache Redis Cluster, Security Groups, VPC Configuration: Redis cache could be exposed to unauthorized access if security groups are misconfigured or if encryption in transit is not properly implemented. An attacker gains access to the Redis cache through a misconfigured security group and extracts sensitive session data.

Insufficient Stream Monitoring and Anomaly Detection [Repudiation, Information Disclosure, CWE-778] on MediaLive Channels, CloudFront Distribution, API Gateway, Lambda Functions: Without proper monitoring and anomaly detection, security incidents or performance issues might go unnoticed. An attacker performs reconnaissance or launches attacks without detection due to insufficient monitoring.
